abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Brostamide reduces side effects compared with Standard care.
conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Brostamide reduces side effects compared with Standard care.
section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. All data for this comparison were collected at the Northgate Heart Cohort.

Table 3. Results for each arm and measure, split by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Side effects | 122 | 500 |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Side effects | 157 | 500 |

Each group is reported in the same way for every measure.
